dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Larry was brought to MACC as a stray with limited information. Larry's finder stated that Larry attempted to bite them and that he is reactive to dogs. While in care, Larry has been observed to have an alert forward body when seeing other dogs while on leash. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult-only home.
dog.name: Larry
